what: Plan-mode aggregation appends tagged blocks verbatim without a required renumber step
scenario_or_breakage: If untagged aggregation emits FINDING_1 and a preserved tagged input was also FINDING_1, ballot.txt contains duplicate IDs and tally-plan-review.sh aborts during split_ballot_to_blocks
suggested_fix: Renumber the combined aggregated-untagged plus preserved-tagged stream sequentially before AGGREGATED=true, and validate duplicate-free headings
